title: Peer review of the pesticide risk assessment of the active substance fenpyroximate
text:
published: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:36:59 +0100 Peer review of the pesticide risk assessment of the active substance fenpyroximate

The conclusions of the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) following the peer review of the initial risk assessments carried out by the competent authorities of the rapporteur Member State, Austria, and co‐rapporteur Member State, Denmark, for the pesticide active substance fenpyroximate and the assessment of application for maximum residue levels (MRLs) and the confirmatory data following the review of the existing MRLs of fenpyroximate, according to Article 12 of Regulation (EC) No 396/2005, are reported.
